scope: Read-only source review and validation of retained synthetic reader receipts. No product acceptance, actual release result, publisher authenticity, workflow provenance, or registry signature verification claim.

finding.problem: Python dict equality treats JSON false as equal to numeric 0, permitting embedded and external manifest type differences.
finding.resolution: Sorted-key JSON serialization comparison preserves parsed value types while ignoring whitespace and object key order.
finding.retainedRegression: Original script falsely passes external sourceDirty=false and embedded sourceDirty=0; revised script fails exactly Embedded and external manifests match.

observations: ZIP members are read in memory without extraction; selected evidence is written to fixed output filenames within a newly created directory. No unsafe output path was found in the reviewed flow.
Candidate/upload hashes are distinguished from signed registry package hashes. Signature and registry execution statements remain explicitly publisher-attested.
The existing pristineMachine=false scope is retained.
All six author-run synthetic reader cases have expected outcomes in the retained receipt; the exact finding has before-and-after evidence.
